BUILDER HANDOFF · STORAGE + NAVIGATION VERIFIED · LAYOUT CONTINUES · 9 NOV 2026
Saved cases: preserve identity, return precisely.
Paper states 09–16 extend the existing R4 candidate. Storage safety and saved-case navigation are implemented in Macro PR #10901 · head 95ac76db194b8952aef0e63c4bcb30a220da78e0 · dependent open Draft. The PR #9580 parent at 5e496c24c962e85a4f7f514dd43dc61443b95cab remains unchanged. Historical fixtures and synthetic local storage are used. The original-condition-first frozen layout and compact review are the next active phase.
01 · Source & fixtures
Continue in templates/crypto_intelligence_r4.js and the existing drawer, hash-route and local-storage owners. Template and served JS/CSS are identical. The two saved pages change only asset-version references; HTML template, builder, source data and shared assets remain unchanged. The navigation phase adds a scoped 44px parent/Close treatment. Source and detailed contract: research/design_candidates/crypto_snapshot_safety_20261109/NAVIGATION.md.

30-day fixture: revision r4-display:2026-10-17:30:continuation; BTC; cutoff 17 Oct 2026; expiry 16 Nov 2026; daily close above $86,595, then stronger spot demand. Its 60 prior closes run 18 Aug–16 Oct; low $64,681. The older 7-day failure fixture uses $81,566 and expires 24 Oct. Keep original horizons and ranges separate. Test time is 18 Oct 2026, 12:00 UTC; preservation cases also retain older save times and digests.
02 · Resolve the saved record
Implemented: the existing mmx.crypto.r4.scenarios.v1 reader separates a ready full collection from unavailable storage. saved-item:<revision> and memory-saved:<revision> require one usable exact match, supported numeric horizon, real cutoff/expiry dates and original bilingual case fields. Duplicate, malformed, missing or unreadable requested versions cannot borrow current scenario data.

Every storage-bearing panel now reads before replacing its subtree and yields to newer route, language or focus ownership. Requested saved context is checked again before parent movement and on arrival. The memory-saved fallback to horizon() and data.as_of is removed. State 16 is unreadable collection; state 11 is unavailable version. A missing legacy issue_evidence digest alone does not invalidate a usable original case.
03 · Return is a parent action
Implemented and verified: managed review with an exact immediate saved-item parent → “← Saved case” → one native history.back(). A review opened from a detached saved-item can still have this real parent. A truly detached review uses “Open saved case” and replaces the current entry with that exact version.

A bounded pending return intent suppresses duplicate activation and matches only the expected arrival. Missing, duplicate or unreadable versions stay on the current entry with explicit recovery. Arrival re-reads before restoring any old content. Close remains the whole-drawer journey exit, never the parent action. No parallel router, history stack or saved-case store is added.
04 · Keep horizons separate
Implemented and verified: saved list items pass their validated original horizon. A 30-day saved case opened from the 7-day view stays 30-day through review, parent return and native Back/Forward. Close restores the original 7-day ancestor and its other route parameters. A legacy parent horizon is repaired through replaceState in the same entry, without a second parent or a changed outer origin.

Original 7-day item H4-0 maps to state 14 / 3BM-0; the 30-day list item maps to state 09 / 3BC-0. Review is state 10 / 3BE-0; detached review is state 15 / 3BO-0; unavailable is state 11 / 3BG-0. State 12 / 3BI-0 is the same saved-item with evidence expanded, not another route.
05 · Original condition first
Next layout phase: for frozen cases show the saved title, asset, horizon, cutoff, original progress and complete condition first. Keep sequence, invalidation, counter-evidence, expiry and prior-close basis under native “Original case details”. Use one “Original evidence” disclosure from captured issue_evidence only; never reconstruct legacy evidence from current data.families.

Temporal rule: status(s) evaluates expiry against today. Keep an expired lifecycle label distinct; only retained original progress may be prefixed “At cutoff”. State 12 has six saved families. Their dates are snapshot_as_of, not verified observation dates. Bitcoin cutoff is 17 Oct; broader market and Participation retain 15 Oct. Quality labels describe capture time. Cutoff, expiry and local save time are distinct. Conditional research is not probability or validated performance.
06 · Focus, scroll & motion
Implemented: one optional history.state.reading object stores panel, revision, original horizon/cutoff, disclosure keys, semantic focus and scroll. It belongs to the rendered URL plus full history metadata, so distinct native entries with the same URL restore independently. Capture before owned actions and locale changes; never copy outgoing DOM into an incoming popstate entry. Native Back restores the last settled scrollend position; explicit actions capture current position.

The existing dialog remains the scroll owner. Named parent returns focus Historical review; recovery that retires its focused control uses the unavailable heading. Outer Close keeps a valid visible opener in the active view or falls back to that view’s heading. Reentrant focus callbacks retain newer navigation. Keep ≥44px parent/Close and disclosure targets, 48px primary action, 320/390px fit, and reduced motion. Frozen body styling remains next.
07 · Explicit save & remove
Implemented in PR #10901: Save and Remove are explicit intents captured from the displayed action. Save when already present makes no write and preserves saved_at and issue_evidence. Remove deletes every exact revision match across the full collection and preserves unrelated parsed entries and their order. Already-absent Remove makes no write and never appends. Only an actual new Save applies the existing 50-snapshot retention policy; opaque entries survive.

Read/parse/shape failures prevent mutation. One write is followed by exact serialized readback before success is announced. Throws, dropped writes, failed or mismatched readback are unconfirmed: no automatic retry or redirect. Completion cannot replace a newer focused control or steal focus after a callback opens another panel. Web Storage read/write/readback does not provide atomic cross-tab compare-and-swap.
08 · Honest recovery & copy
Implemented state 11 has no borrowed asset, horizon, cutoff or condition and exposes “Open saved snapshots” plus deliberate “Open current outlook”. State 16 uses “Saved snapshots unavailable” / “Saved snapshots couldn’t be read.” “Try reading again” uses the existing reader; no background retry owner exists. Recovery spacing and primary treatment remain in the layout phase.

“No changes were made” is only valid before a write. A confirmed removal followed by a failed list read must use neutral copy. Already-absent removal: “This snapshot is no longer saved on this device.” Unconfirmed write: “The change couldn’t be confirmed. Check Saved snapshots before trying again.” An unreadable collection is never called empty. Legacy state 14 keeps its original case and missing-digest explanation.
09 · Required browser proof
Passing coverage now includes 39 contract + 61 browser cases. The initial navigation run returned 93 passed / 7 failed: six misplaced initial-entry focus assertions and one removal injection that ran after the destination render. The diagnostic and original failures are retained. After correcting only the harness, all 10 affected cases passed; three overlap earlier passes. Runtime JS/CSS stayed unchanged. This is not one 100-pass run.

Chrome 157.0.8103.39: initial 62 contexts / 68 pages; correction 10 / 10; zero page errors or external/WebSocket requests. Verified managed/detached returns, native Back/Forward, same-URL distinct entries, locale reading state, original horizons, missing/duplicate/unreadable cases, disappearance before arrival, and newer focus ownership. Three new native navigation crops inspected at 1440 EN, 390 ZH and 320 EN. Next prove the changed frozen hierarchy, compact review and local action spacing.
10 · Delivery & acceptance
Paper states 09–16 remain the full applied design amendment. Storage and navigation are locally verified at PR #10901 head 95ac76db194b8952aef0e63c4bcb30a220da78e0; the original-condition-first frozen layout and compact review remain active work. Nineteen source/evidence files and three new capture binaries have exact commit readback. No merge, deployment, hosted/independent visual acceptance or production replacement is claimed.

Preserve R4 source drawer GB-0, scenario page BB-0, alert gate HE-0 and public-route cutover gate QQ-0. H5/model authority remains held. Historical/synthetic proof does not establish current freshness, personal activity, forecast skill, model allocation or alert delivery. Dialog crops alone do not establish full-viewport desktop toast placement.
)
